text: こんな　ところへ　なにしに　きたんだよ？

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of coming or going shows what you come or go to do. なにしに　きた = 'came to do what'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and, in a question, pushes for an explanation. With よ it sounds rough and demanding. きたんだよ = 'what did you come for, huh?'
